one_line: An Ethiopian-origin Habshi general and statesman who rose to power in the Deccan sultanates in the early 17th century.

appearance.age_look: mid-40s, athletic but lean, with the calm authority of a seasoned commander
appearance.face: oval face with high cheekbones, deep brown complexion, strong straight nose, neatly trimmed full beard and moustache, intense almond-shaped dark eyes with a focused gaze, default expression serious yet composed
appearance.hair: short tightly curled black hair, close to the scalp, partially covered by a deep indigo Deccani-style turban wrapped low and firm with a thin gold border and a small white feather tucked on the left side
appearance.costume: long-sleeved white cotton jama (Mughal–Deccan style robe) crossing right over left and tied with internal ties, worn under a sleeveless quilted dark indigo leather-cloth coat reaching mid-thigh with simple vertical stitching; wide straight trousers in muted sand-beige tucked into soft mid-calf brown leather boots; at the waist a broad maroon cloth patka sash wrapped twice and knotted slightly to the left with the loose end hanging; over his shoulders a light grey cotton shawl with a subtle woven chevron pattern, draped from left shoulder across the back and brought under the right arm; minimal jewellery: a single plain gold signet ring on the right hand and small gold stud earrings; no fantastical armour, only a simple steel bracer on his left forearm and a round unembellished steel shield hung behind his back
appearance.signature: a slightly curved Deccani talwar with a dark steel blade, traditional disc pommel hilt in brass, and a simple maroon fabric-wrapped grip, carried sheathed in a plain brown leather scabbard slung at his left hip and gripped in his right hand in action poses

ref_desc: Malik Ambar is a mid-40s Ethiopian-origin Habshi commander with deep brown skin, short curled black hair under a deep indigo turban, white jama, indigo coat, maroon sash, beige trousers, steel bracer, and a maroon-hilted Deccani talwar.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Malik Ambar, a mid-40s Ethiopian-origin Habshi commander with deep brown skin and an athletic build, showing him from multiple angles while keeping his features consistent: an oval face with high cheekbones, strong nose, intense almond dark eyes, and a neatly trimmed full beard and moustache, wearing short tightly curled black hair mostly covered by a deep indigo Deccani turban edged with a thin gold border and a small white feather on the left. His outfit is an era-accurate 17th-century Deccan ensemble: a long-sleeved white cotton jama robe crossing right over left, under a sleeveless quilted dark indigo mid-thigh coat with simple vertical stitching, wide sand-beige straight trousers tucked into soft brown leather mid-calf boots, and a broad maroon cloth patka sash wrapped twice at the waist with a knot and loose end to the left. Add a light grey cotton shawl with a subtle woven chevron pattern draped from the left shoulder across his back and under the right arm, a plain gold ring on his right hand and small gold stud earrings, plus a simple steel bracer on his left forearm and a plain round steel shield hanging behind his back. His signature weapon is a slightly curved Deccani talwar with a dark steel blade and brass disc-pommel hilt, the grip wrapped in maroon fabric, sheathed in a brown leather scabbard at his left hip but also shown unsheathed in one pose. Use a palette dominated by deep indigo, maroon, white, sand-beige, steel grey, and rich brown, and present him with a serious yet composed commanding expression in every view.
